note: Hasan Minaj talks to Malcom Gladwell. One topic is where Gladwell apologizes for his 'broken windows' suggestions where focusing on a relatively trivial aspect can have profound impacts on crime (broken windows theory, fix broken windows, fix crime rate). This was used as justification for the stop and frisk aggressive policing by the NYPD. After it was deemed unconstitutional and removed from use by the NYPD, crime rate went down even faster and Gladwell later apologized. This is one of those policies that sounds neat and cute but it wrong, can lead to profoundly bad policy and shifts focus from the underlying causes.
